fields.FIR_Description: As per the FIR recorded on 2026-07-12, the complainant contributed to a local chit group, and after the organiser failed to pay the maturity amount of Rs. 4,50,000, contact was lost. The time of the incident was given as 15:55 on 2026-06-29. The online submission was made by Gunasekar Murugan (9000000210). Transaction details refer to the receiving account SYN-ACC-100008. The complaint refers to Kavitha Sri, a person who arranged the contact, reachable on 9000000129. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Harish Murugan, using the number 9000000180.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Social media screenshot; Bank transaction reference
fields.Modus_Operandi: Chit contributions reportedly collected in cash and through transfers.
